column1: # Source: California DMV autonomous vehicle disengagement and mileage reports

# Notes: Report year runs Dec 1 to Nov 30. 2020 onward from the DMV consolidated CSVs (per-VIN rows summed per permit); 2019 from the DMV spreadsheets; earlier years from each company's filed PDF (text layer or OCR
column2: as source_method records). What counts as a reportable disengagement is self-defined by each company under 13 CCR 227.50
column3: and the DMV states the reports are not designed for comparison across companies. Commercial deployment miles are excluded by regulation. The live DMV page returned 404 on the fetch date; files came from the DMV-hosted bundle the archived page links.
